contentItem.title: 性质与证明：可公度量与中项无理线段与比例
contentItem.englishTitle: A straight line commensurable with the side of a rational plus a medial area is itself also the side of a rational plus a medial area.

revision.changeSummary: Imported Heath source and machine-assisted Chinese draft. No mathematical or editorial review is implied.

surfaces.text: A straight line commensurable with the side of a rational plus a medial area is itself also the side of a rational plus a medial area.
可公度线,加上有理加中项无理线段区域,本身就是有理加中项无理线段区域。（相关点与线段：A）
Let AB be the side of a rational plus a medial area, and let CD be commensurable with AB; it is to be proved that CD is also the side of a rational plus a medial area.
让AB成为有理加中项无理线段区的一面,让CD成为可公度,AB成为AB;必须证明,CD也是有理加中项无理线段区的一面。

Let AB be divided into its straight lines at E; therefore AE, EB are straight lines incommensurable in square which make the sum of the squares on them medial, but the rectangle contained by them rational. [[X. 40](/principles/euclid-10-40)]
AB线在E线上划成直线;因此,正方形中共有AE线,EB线是不可公度,中项无理线段上共有正方形,有理则有矩形。 [[X. 40](/principles/euclid-10-40)]
Let the same construction be made as before.

We can then prove similarly that CF, FD are incommensurable in square, and the sum of the squares on AE, EB is commensurable with the sum of the squares on CF, FD, and the rectangle AE, EB with the rectangle CF, FD; so that the sum of the squares on CF, FD is also medial, and the rectangle CF, FD rational.
由此,我们可证明,正方形的不可公度、FD和不可公度的正方形,AE、EB和正方形,FD和矩形,AE和矩形,EB,EB和矩形,CF和FD;因此,CF和FD的正方形和中项无理线段,矩形和CF,CF和FD,有理。
Therefore CD is the side of a rational plus a medial area. Q. E. D.
因此,CD是有理加中项无理线段区的一面。 Q. E,D。
